humanFeedback.evidence: All six reported M4.3 results and request_revision are recorded verbatim and conservatively normalized; Choice Memory remains PASS.

actDifferentiation.evidence: Typed semantic contracts and browser controls distinguish spatial survey, incomplete-evidence interpretation, and direct irreversible commitment.

tradeoffs.evidence: All nine decisions declare opportunity, relinquishment, uncertainty, and at least three affected qualitative dimensions; no player-facing numeric stats.

journeyPacing.evidence: Arrival, approach, two travel beats after Acts I and II, evidence inspection, history gathering, culmination, and reflection add meaningful action without enforced time.

sceneProgression.evidence: A single wide SVG camera travels through divided ground, watercourse basin, and dusk rise while route and landmarks persist.

narrativeMotion.evidence: Camera, traveler, route drawing, current, marker/signal response, and morning-to-dusk atmosphere carry meaning.

reducedMotion.evidence: Reduced motion makes transitions immediate while preserving regions, route memory, state, and information.

choiceMemoryRegression.evidence: All 27 ordered histories remain valid/deterministic; divergent Bearing I histories differ later in state, prose, and visible route.

bilingualParity.evidence: Natural project-authored zh-CN/en cover all new controls, traces, tradeoffs, travel, culmination, and reflection; switching preserves evidence and region.

desktopMatrix.evidence: Complete journeys pass at 1024x768, 1440x900, and 1920x1080 without horizontal overflow.

keyboardAccessibility.evidence: Keyboard completes all three primitives; representative bilingual states have no serious or critical axe findings.

runtimeIsolation.evidence: Production runtime makes no external requests and emits no console/page errors.

deterministicReplay.evidence: Fresh identical browser histories reproduce signature, reflection, and recap.

independentAudit.evidence: Fresh independent revision audit verdict pass_with_warnings.

warnings: The 5-8 minute target is plausible from the expanded 20-action first path and four observe/traverse beats but remains unmeasured; only first-time human replay can establish duration and felt journey length.
Act II evidence inspection gates interpretation but remains shallowly coupled: any two traces unlock the same three actions.
Acts II and III show concise benefit-cost cues but do not render each option's full authored uncertainty field in the final action list.
Gathered marker transforms last 1.1 seconds while the interaction lock lasts 0.9 seconds, leaving up to 0.2 seconds of non-blocking visual settlement after final choices unlock.
Bilingual literary tone, felt hesitation, act distinctness, motion quality/restraint, Choice Memory salience, and ending earnedness remain human judgments.
Accessibility automation is representative rather than complete WCAG or physical assistive-technology validation.
Final QA/gate generation, artifact-chain validation, and the final repository-wide npm run check remain required after this audit; this warning does not authorize release or M5.
Automated accessibility scans are representative, not complete WCAG conformance.
Felt hesitation, 5–8 minute first-play pacing, motion quality, and bilingual naturalness remain human judgments.
humanOnlyLimitations: Automation cannot answer the 13 re-playtest questions, approve Release Readiness, establish subjective deliberation or earnedness, or claim mobile support.
